name: Docker 管理
author: ServerDeck
description: 管理 Docker 容器与镜像，查看详情、日志并打开容器终端。

args: export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"dockerInstalled":false,"dockerState":"absent"}'; else d version --format '{{json .}}'; fi

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; d container ls --all --no-trunc --format '{{json .}}'

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; d image ls --all --no-trunc --digests --format '{{json .}}'

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; sd_ids=$(d container ls --all --quiet --no-trunc) || exit; if test -n "$sd_ids"; then set -f; d container inspect --format '{"Id":{{json .Id}},"Name":{{json .Name}},"Created":{{json .Created}},"Config":{"Image":{{json .Config.Image}}},"State":{{json .State}},"NetworkSettings":{"Ports":{{json .NetworkSettings.Ports}}},"Mounts":{{json .Mounts}},"HostConfig":{"RestartPolicy":{{json .HostConfig.RestartPolicy}}}}' -- $sd_ids; fi

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; sd_ids=$(d container ls --all --quiet --no-trunc) || exit; if test -n "$sd_ids"; then set -f; d container inspect --format '{"Id":{{json .Id}},"Config":{"Env":{{json .Config.Env}}}}' -- $sd_ids; fi

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; d stats --all --no-stream --no-trunc --format '{{json .}}'
